_comment: THE single source of truth for the Confluence dimensions, the runner method table and the named presets (spec docs/specs/2026-09-12-method-switch-design.md §3). Nothing else in this repo may hard-code any of the three: scripts/methods.py is the reader, scripts/sync-methods.py regenerates the derived schema enums, and scripts/tests/test_methods_sync.py fails the build if any copy drifts. Twin of instruments.json.

wyckoff.label: Wyckoff
wyckoff.note: Phase A-E vocabulary, doi nhan tests, Effort-vs-Result, SOT, Volume Profile (user decision 2026-09-10). NOT the same thing as the runner's mechanical WYCKOFF method -- see runner_methods.

ict.label: ICT
ict.note: `knowledge/ict/core-a.md`–`knowledge/ict/models.md` carry no volume of any kind; volume is the only orthogonal axis against Wyckoff (SYSTEM-DESIGN.md §6.1).

label.en: Position in the dealing range (premium / discount)
label.vi: Vị trí trong dealing range (Premium / Discount)

footprint.label: Footprint
footprint.note: No commodities source: CoinGlass is crypto-derivatives only (SYSTEM-DESIGN.md §12 item 3).

heatmap.label: Heatmap
heatmap.note: Same CoinGlass limit. No ingested knowledge/ source either (SYSTEM-DESIGN.md §12 item 1).

_pane_note: The second chart pane under the price chart, one declared slot per dimension (docs/specs/2026-09-12-chart-lightweight-charts-design.md follow-up, 2026-09-12: replacing an ICT pane apology with a real reading and making the slot declarable). `kind` is one of: `volume` (Wyckoff's rolling-mean volume read, unchanged), `range_pct` (ICT's per-bar position within the dealing range, 0-100%, EQ marked at 50 -- knowledge/ict/core-a.md §2.18-2.19, R13), `unavailable` (footprint/heatmap: no live CoinGlass source yet, so the pane states that honestly instead of standing empty). `label` is the pane's own display name. scripts/build-artifact.py reads this into PARAMS.panes (the only source; there is no second lane->pane-kind list); scripts/chart.js renders each kind with its own function. A 5th dimension needs only a `pane` entry here plus one render branch in chart.js -- scripts/tests/test_methods.py fails the build if a dimension has no `pane` or an unknown `kind`.
_runner_note: requires[] is the dimension gate, NOT a claim that the runner reproduces that dimension's full read. The runner's WYCKOFF-BOOK is a mechanical rule set (scripts/wyckoff_rules.py: CHoCH gate, TR from SC/AR, Spring vs Shakeout, VP veto); the wyckoff DIMENSION is the skill's discretionary read. Homonyms in spirit only now -- there is no second, looser 'WYCKOFF' runner method any more (removed 2026-09-19, docs/audits/2026-09-19-knowledge-fidelity.md finding 6: its trading range was a rolling R-bar min/max with no CHoCH gate and no Phase A/B, so it could fire a "Spring" mid-trend with no accumulation structure behind it at all; COMBINED and PARTIAL, which paired that same range with an ICT confirmation, were removed with it). runnable=false means backtest-only (scripts/backtest-methods.py); scan picks which causal scanner in strategy-runner.py produces the setups.

SOLO.note: Added 2026-09-12, user's explicit decision, changing a rule inherited from the master spec: a single engaged dimension has no cross-confirmation to lean on, so the score bar is raised above NORMAL's -- equal to STRICT's 85 -- rather than lowering the minimum without compensating. Reachability: raw_pct for one engaged dimension is (points / 25) x 100 (SYSTEM-DESIGN.md section 6.2 item 2), so 85 needs 21.25/25 -- attainable at e.g. 22/25 (a near-flawless single-dimension read across all of that dimension's evidence buckets) without requiring literal 25/25, the same style of headroom that makes STRICT's 85 reachable at 3 dimensions (worked example in section 6.2). MUST be applied only via a preset's own declared `mode` field (below) -- never derived from how many dimensions happened to be engaged at analysis time. See SYSTEM-DESIGN.md section 6.2 'SOLO mode' for the full rule and the preset-not-runtime safeguard this closes.
SOLO.max_unresolved_high_impact_note: 0, same as STRICT: a single engaged dimension has no second lane to weigh an unresolved HIGH-impact contradiction against, so there is nothing for tolerance to be tolerant OF. Same reasoning that raised SOLO's threshold to 85 rather than lowering its minimum.

NORMAL.note: Unchanged from the master spec (SYSTEM-DESIGN.md section 6.1).

ENHANCED.note: Unchanged from the master spec (SYSTEM-DESIGN.md section 6.1).

STRICT.note: Unchanged from the master spec (SYSTEM-DESIGN.md section 6.1); also requires zero unresolved high-impact contradictions, enforced in the DecisionAgent procedure, not this table.

_modes_note: The ONLY source for methodology-mode minimum/threshold pairs (SYSTEM-DESIGN.md section 6.2); scripts/methods.py reads this instead of a hand-kept constant. Every preset below MUST name one of these modes in its own `mode` field, and that field is the SOLE way a run's mode may be SOLO -- see the mode-lock / preset-not-runtime rule in SYSTEM-DESIGN.md section 6.2.
_preset_note: `mode` is the methodology mode this preset resolves to when /analyze is not given an explicit MODE argument, and (for SOLO specifically) the ONLY legal mode for that preset -- SOLO may never be requested for a preset naming more than one dimension (SYSTEM-DESIGN.md section 6.2). `tier` is a display grouping only (trade = can produce a live TRADE verdict at all; nothing is tagged research any more now that SOLO makes the single-dimension presets tradeable -- 2026-09-12, user's explicit decision). Preset dimension sets MUST stay pairwise distinct or profile_of stops being a function -- scripts/methods.py raises on load if they collide.

history.change: initial registry: 4 dimensions, 6 runner methods, 6 presets
history.reason: extracted from automation.py MARKET_DIMENSIONS, build-artifact.py LANES, strategy-runner.py METHODS and rank-setups.py RUNNABLE, which had drifted into 2-3 hand-kept copies

history.change: added a `modes` table (NORMAL/ENHANCED/STRICT unchanged; new SOLO mode: minimum 1, threshold 85) and a `mode` field on every preset; retagged `wyckoff` and `ict` from tier:research to tier:trade
history.reason: wyckoff and ict are the only single-dimension presets and were structurally unable to ever pass /analyze's NORMAL minimum of 2 (SYSTEM-DESIGN.md section 6.1), making them permanently research-only; the user wants them usable for real entries. SOLO raises the score bar to 85 (vs NORMAL's 70) to compensate for having no cross-confirming dimension, and is gated to presets that themselves name exactly one dimension -- never derived from a multi-dimension preset degrading to one engaged dimension at runtime (e.g. CoinGlass down), which must keep failing NO TRADE on count exactly as before. This changes a scoring-mode rule inherited from the master spec (SYSTEM-DESIGN.md section 6.1/6.2 previously said minimums are 'unchanged from the master spec').

history.change: added a `pane` field (kind + label) to every dimension, declaring what the chart's second pane under the price chart shows for that dimension
history.reason: the ICT pane was empty with an implementation-note apology explaining that volume does not belong to ICT and the pane was left blank so the chart would keep its size across method switches; the user asked for it removed and replaced with a real ICT reading (dealing-range position, EQ at 0.5) instead of an unexplained empty box, and for the slot to be declarable so footprint/heatmap can fill it once they have a live source rather than silently going empty again.

history.change: removed runner methods WYCKOFF, COMBINED and PARTIAL (6 runner methods -> 3: WYCKOFF-BOOK, ICT, COMBINED-BOOK)
history.reason: docs/audits/2026-09-19-knowledge-fidelity.md finding 6: WYCKOFF's trading range was a rolling min(low)/max(high) over the previous R bars, with no CHoCH gate and no Phase A/B -- the books (knowledge/wyckoff/advance.md:280,283,302, WA p68-72) permit a trading range only AFTER three CHoBEV confirm a CHoCH, bordered by the SC/ST low and the AR high, so the proxy could fire a "Spring" mid-trend with no accumulation structure behind it at all. COMBINED (the same proxy range entered via an ICT FVG/MSS confirmation) and PARTIAL (half-size at the WYCKOFF entry, half at the COMBINED entry) depended entirely on that same unfaithful range and were removed with it. Measured under FTMO-style account rules (data/history/stability/cfd-ftmo-challenge-phase1.json): WYCKOFF failed 9/9 rows (expectancy -1.85R..-0.14R); WYCKOFF-BOOK (scripts/wyckoff_rules.py -- SC, 3xCHoBEV, CHoCH, AR, ST, Phase B, Spring/Shakeout typing, Test, Phase D -- already implements the books) passed 3/9 including the best row in the table (4H cfg C: +1.10R, 2.8% max drawdown). Runnable set is now exactly {ICT, WYCKOFF-BOOK}; COMBINED-BOOK stays runnable=false (median/max n = 0-1 setup across every stability row measured).

_i18n_note: User-facing strings in this registry carry one entry per locale in docs/architecture/i18n.json `locales`: `dimensions.*.reads`, `dimensions.*.pane.label` and `presets[].label`. `dimensions.*.label` (Wyckoff, ICT, Footprint, Heatmap) stays a bare string -- a methodology name is a proper noun and reads the same in every language. scripts/methods.py is the only reader; scripts/tests/test_i18n.py fails the build if a locale is missing.
_expectation_note: CLAUDE.md §17 lists the expectation kinds each methodology may produce. They live on the dimension because they ARE that methodology's vocabulary -- scripts/expectation.py reads this and refuses a kind belonging to another methodology, which is how §17's 'multiple methodologies must maintain independent expectations' is enforced rather than merely intended.
_contradiction_note: CLAUDE.md §19: contradiction tolerance is a property of the active configuration, not of the code that evaluates it. `max_unresolved_high_impact` is the count a mode will still trade through; scripts/confluence.py enforces it. Contradictions themselves are never resolved silently -- htf_context.bias_of returns neutral and keeps BOTH readings in the basis.
